expertiseGrid.subtitle: Years of experience

items.title: Contract and liability law
items.description: We assist with drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts tailored to your needs. From commercial agreements to general terms and conditions, we ensure clarity and compliance. We also advise on liability matters, including disputes, damages and representation in legal proceedings.

items.title: Employment law
items.description: We advise both employers and employees on all aspects of employment law — from drafting contracts to resolving employment disputes. Our services include sickness absence, contract changes, dismissal and more. We also provide in-company training and practical legal support to prevent costly disputes.

items.title: Education law
items.description: Education law encompasses several areas of law, including employment law, governance and liability. We provide strategic advice and legal support on matters such as mergers, restructurings, board changes, employee participation and funding. We also provide training for school boards, supervisory boards and participation councils.

items.title: Financial criminal law
items.description: Whether you are facing serious criminal cases or economic offences, our attorneys provide proactive and expert defence. We also handle international cases, including extradition, cross-border crime and proceedings before international courts. In addition, we advise NGOs on prosecution and investigation options in international criminal cases.

items.title: Human rights
items.description: Our attorneys are committed to pro bono work and support individuals and organisations with limited means, particularly in the areas of human rights, freedom of expression, discrimination and international crimes. We also assist people in vulnerable situations in civil, administrative and criminal matters. Due to limited capacity, a selection of cases may be made.
